messages:
maria (platform): kicking off v2 rollout to eu-west-1 now — small canary (1%) for 30m. release notes pushed to docs: https://internal/docs/releases/v2-eu

deploy-bot: deploy started for service=api-gateway target=v2 region=eu-west-1 canary=1% window=30m (id=deploy-6311223344) :rocket:

tom (runtime): heads-up — we saw a slight uptick in response time on the canary last run, nothing alarming but monitoring. cpu ~70%.

jen (ops): saw 5xxs in the last 5m in the eu pool, small spike (5 errors total). can someone paste logs?

sriniv (sre): grabbing logs now, seems serialization error from a new enum field in v2 -> downstream consumer choking. pattern: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data` on /v2/parse endpoint.

maria (platform): hmm — that matches what the schema change review warned about. We can either rollback v2 in eu or steer traffic back to v1 while we hotfix. Thoughts?

jen (ops): prefer steering weight fast, keep release notes accurate. customers may be using strict parsers.

deploy-bot: suggested action: `shift-weight --from v2 --to v1 --percent 90 --region eu-west-1` — will do if approved.

maria (platform): approve. do 90% to v1, keep 10% v2 for debugging. tag the tenants impacted and add a ephemeral shim route that strips the new enum.

deploy-bot: executing `deploy-bot shift-weight --from v2 --to v1 --percent 90 --region eu-west-1 --dry-run=false`

deploy-bot: weight shift completed. routing now: v1=90% v2=10% in eu-west-1. (op-id=op-9a3f) :white_check_mark:

tom (runtime): confirmed 5xxs dropped to baseline. keeping 10% ramp to capture logs for the failing traces.

jen (ops): updating release notes: added "Known issue: strict JSON parsers may return 5xx in eu - steering to v1 until patch" and pinging customer success to warn major tenants in EU.

maria (platform): opened a hotfix PR that normalizes incoming enum values back-compat in the v2 parser. tagging @tom to review the runtime patch. PR: https://git/repo/pull/482

tom (runtime): will review now. if tests pass we can canary the fix to the 10% v2 slice, then lift weight.

sriniv (sre): adding a temporary alert mute for the canary 5xx alarm in eu while we validate the fix, so we don't page on expected small residual errors. will set expire=2h.

jen (ops): customer success notified: email queued to EU enterprise tenants. also updating the public changelog to reflect the temporary steering and ETA for fix (approx 2h).

deploy-bot: ops checklist updated: `ops: routing-shift complete`, `sre: mute applied`, `platform: hotfix PR opened`, `cs: customers notified` — all marked in the deploy issue.

maria (platform): great work. once PR is merged, run small v2 canary (5%) then 25% then full. keep release notes locked until full lift. I'll follow up in 30m for status. :eyes:
